{{Quote|I've always wanted to have a chunk of star destroyer for my trophy collection!|Dalgas|<ref name="Freedom Station" />}}
'''Dalgas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Following a patrol mission near [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], Dalgas was transferred to [[Freedom Station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. He was assigned to lead a wing of the station's interception force against Imperial attacks.<ref name="Freedom Station" />
